newsitem.title: MOROCCO: SOREAD firm to sell French TV decoders in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: SOREAD firm to sell French TV decoders in Morocco.

text.p: Morocco's state-run audiovisual SOREAD firm has signed an agreement with French satellite private television Canal Plus Horizon to distribute exclusively its decoders in the country, the company said on Tuesday.

SOREAD, in which the ONA Group, Morocco's largest private conglomerate, has a stake of more than 17 percent, was established in 1989 in Casablanca and has a capital of 495 million dirhams ($57.5 million), the company said in a statement.
The firm is responsible for the management of Morocco's private television 2M.
The government, which acquired SOREAD earlier this year, has injected more than 100 million dirhams in its capital to boost the activity of the loss-making firm.
Canal Plus Horizon decoders are not at present distributed in Morocco.
